race.comment: SIRAGUSA (1) found the lead in the straight and looked home, only for Graffiti Tycoon to nail him on the line last start over this trip at Randwick. That winner subsequently scored impressively at Kembla on Saturday. Rock-hard fit after four runs back and that form line looks the goods in this field. REBEL RHAPSODY (2) led for the judge but was swamped late and finished a close fourth when resuming over today's journey at Hawkesbury last time out. Is a winner here at the trip and strips fitter. Clear danger. HEY JUDE (6) did a good job to lead the field and hold on under 61.5kgs at Goulburn recently. Genuine mare who is up in grade but drops 5kgs so she must come under consideration. CHILLY CHARLIE (7) stalked REBEL RHAPSODY and just got the better of him to clock in third when fresh from a spell over this trip at Hawkesbury last start. Doesn't win often but looks to be back in fine fettle. The speedy REAL BAKER (5) resumes. Should come to hand quickly and will give some cheek.
